name: autoaway
description: Away when you're idle or nobody is attached, back when you return; on or off per network, away and back announced per channel if you like

name: awaylog
description: Your highlights and private messages while you were away or detached, summed up in the tab you're on when you come back

name: preview
description: Webchat only: a preview under links people post. The page's title, description and picture, the picture itself for image links, a player for audio and video links

name: seen
description: /seen nick: when and where someone was last seen talking, joining, leaving, quitting or renaming; answers !seen in channels you pick
